title: CardHoldAuthorized / CardHoldDeclined v1 payload
description: The order's history event when operations applies the payment's card-hold decision (aggregate Order, version = order version). The payment's event of the same type is card-hold.v1. CardHoldAuthorized: the search starts (or the pre-order is scheduled); CardHoldDeclined: the order is UNFULFILLED with PAYMENT_DECLINED, or with PAYMENT_TIMEOUT when the bank did not answer before the hold deadline (REQ-PAY-02; the hold is then released, a late success voided).

reason.description: CardHoldDeclined only: the bank's reason, Declined, or PAYMENT_TIMEOUT for the hold deadline.
